SWS_Pwm_00001:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm SWS does not cover PWM emulation on general purpose I/O.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00007:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_Init shall initialize all internals variables and the used PWM structure of the microcontroller according to the parameters specified in ConfigPtr.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00010:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_DeInit shall de-initialize the PWM module.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00011:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_DeInit shall set the state of the PWM output signals to the idle state.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00012:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_DeInit shall disable PWM interrupts and PWM signal edge notifications.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00013:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall set the duty cycle of the PWM channel.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00014:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body When the requested duty cycle is either 0% or 100%, the function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall set the PWM output state to either PWM_HIGH or PWM_LOW, with regard to both the configured polarity parameter and the requested duty cycle. Thus for 0% requested Duty Cycle the output will be the inverse of the configured polarity parameter, and for 100% Duty Cycle the output will be equal to the configured polarity parameter.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00016:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall modulate the PWM output signal according to parameters period, duty cycle and configured polarity, when the duty cycle > 0 % and < 100%.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00017:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetDutyCycle shall update the duty cycle always at the end of the period if supported by the implementation and configured with PwmDutycycleUpdatedEndperiod.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00018:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The driver shall forbid the spike on the PWM output signal.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00019:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall set the period and the duty cycle of a PWM channel.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00020:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body When updating the PWM period and duty, the driver shall repress any spikes on the PWM output signal.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00021:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle shall set immediately the PWM output to the configured Idle state.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00022:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_GetOutputState shall read the internal state of the PWM output signal and return it as defined in the diagram below.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00023:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_DisableNotification shall disable the PWM signal edge notification.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00024:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall enable the PWM signal edge notification according to notification parameter.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00025:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm module shall call the function Pwm_Notification_<#Channel> accordingly to the last call of Pwm_EnableNotification and Pwm_DisableNotification for channel <#Channel>.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00026:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm module shall reset the interrupt flag associated to the notification Pwm_Notification_<#Channel>
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00041:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall allow changing the period only for the PWM channel declared as variable Period type.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00045:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled: The API Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall check if the given PWM channel is of the channel class type PWM_VARIABLE_PERIOD. If this is not the case the development error PWM_E_PERIOD_UNCHANGEABLE shall be called.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00047:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled: the PWM functions shall check the parameter ChannelNumber and raise development error PWM_E_PARAM_CHANNEL if the parameter ChannelNumber is invalid.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00052:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_Init shall disable all notifications.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00058:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The width of the duty cycle parameter is 16 Bits.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00059:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm module shall comply with the following scaling scheme for the duty cycle: • 0x0000 means 0%. • 0x8000 means 100%. 0x8000 gives the highest resolution while allowing 100% duty cycle to be represented with a 16 bit value.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00062:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_Init shall only initialize the configured resources and shall not touch resources that are not configured in the configuration file.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00065:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm SWS shall not define the code file structure.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00070:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body All time units used within the API services of the PWM module shall be of the unit ticks.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00076:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty shall update the period always at the end of the current period if supported by the implementation and configured with PwmPeriodUpdatedEndperiod.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00081:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The function Pwm_EnableNotification shall cancel pending interrupts.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00088:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body All functions from the PWM module except Pwm_Init, Pwm_DeInit and Pwm_GetVersionInfo shall be re-entrant for different PWM channel numbers.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00089:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm module’s user shall ensure the integrity if several function calls are made during run time in different tasks or ISRs for the same PWM channel.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00093:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The users of the Pwm module shall not call the function Pwm_Init during a running operation.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00094:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of imported datatypes of module Pwm
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00095:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of API function Pwm_Init
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00096:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of API function Pwm_DeInit
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00100:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of API function Pwm_GetOutputState
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00103:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of API function Pwm_GetVersionInfo
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00104:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of optional interfaces requested by module Pwm
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00105:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00106:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of datatype Pwm_ChannelType
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00107:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of datatype Pwm_PeriodType
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00108:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of datatype Pwm_OutputStateType
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00109:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of datatype Pwm_EdgeNotificationType
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00110:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of datatype Pwm_ChannelClassType
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00111:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body Definition of datatype Pwm_ConfigType
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00116:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm module’s environment shall not call any function of the Pwm module before having called Pwm_Init.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00117:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body If development error detection for the Pwm module is enabled: if any function (except Pwm_Init) is called before Pwm_Init has been called, the called function shall raise development error PWM_E_UNINIT.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00118:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body If development error detection is enabled, calling the routine Pwm_Init while the PWM driver and hardware are already initialized will cause a development error PWM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED. The desired functionality shall be left without any action.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00119:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body After the call of the function Pwm_SetOutputToIdle, fixed period type channels shall be reactivated using only the API Pwm_SetDutyCycle to activate the PWM channel with the old period.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00121:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body A re-initialization of the Pwm driver by executing the Pwm_Init function requires a de-initialization before by executing a Pwm_DeInit.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00150:

Verification Status Verified
Type System
Body If the period is set to zero the setting of the duty-cycle is not relevant. In this case the output shall be zero (zero percent duty-cycle).
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00154:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The PwmDriver shall support power state changes and its APIs when the corresponding configuration parameter PwmLowPowerStatesSupport is set to TRUE.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00155:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body If the parameter PwmLowPowerStatesSupport is enabled then the APIs Pwm_PreparePowerState, Pwm_SetPowerState, Pwm_GetCurrentPowerState, Pwm_GetTargetPowerState shall be generated and shall be used to manage and get informations on power state transitions.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00156:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The APIs Pwm_GetTargetPowerState and Pwm_GetCurrentPowerState shall be respectively used to gather information on the requested and the target Pwm power states.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00157:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The API Pwm_PreparePowerState shall be used to start a power state transition.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00158:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body After preparation for a power state is achieved by ([SWS_Pwm_00157]) then the API Pwm_SetPowerState shall be used to achieve the requested power state of the Pwm module. In order to avoid incoherent power state conditions, some APIs (Pwm_SetPowerState, Pwm_PreparePowerState) have to be called in a given sequence, otherwise an error (if DET tracing is enabled) is stored and the action is interrupted. The Pwm Driver keeps track of the call sequence.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00159:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm Driver shall keep track of the call order of the APIs Pwm_SetPowerState and Pwm_PreparePowerState. In case the first one is called before the second one is called, a DET entry shall be stored and the action shall not be executed.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00160:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body The Pwm Module shall keep track of the current and of the target powerstate if the parameter PwmLowPowerStatesSupport is set to TRUE.
No Mappings

SWS_Pwm_00161:

Verification Status Not Verified
Type System
Body After the Initiliazation the power state of the module shall be always FULL POWER if the PwmLowPowerStatesSupport is set to TRUE.
No Mappings
